history.summary: An integrated development directly on top of Buangkok MRT (10m) with mall, hawker centre and community club — best-in-class connectivity and amenity for a D19 1BR. At $910k / $1920 psf it sits below the $2067 project median, and the 367-txn series gives a reliable ~2.9% resale CAGR.
history.rating_rationale: Integrated/transit-oriented developments command durable resale and rental premiums; this one is literally on the MRT with an attached mall. $1920 psf vs $2067 median is a ~7% discount, and 367 txns make the data trustworthy. 1BR is niche but the integrated-mall location is the deepest possible tenant pool for the format. Low quantum ($910k) keeps it liquid. Downside: 1BR resale appeals mainly to investors, and the ~2.9% resale rate is OCR-typical not stellar.
red_flags: 1BR is investor/single-tenant niche — narrower owner-occupier resale pool
~2.9% resale CAGR is modest (OCR-typical), not a growth standout
High PSF for D19 (paying integrated-development premium up front)
catalysts: Direct integrated connection to Buangkok MRT + Sengkang Grand Mall + hawker centre
Below-median entry PSF (7% under project median)
Punggol Digital District tenant demand in the broader NE corridor

history.summary: 4BR (1,324 sqft) asking $3.79M / $2,862 psf at an integrated D19 development whose trailing 12-month prints run $1,875-$2,210 psf (avg ~$2,027, project median $2,067 on 367 txns). The ask is +29% above the highest print in a year, +41% vs the 12-month average, and +27% above an identical-size 4BR listed in the same building at $2.99M ($2,258 psf). The MRT/mall integration is a level premium already embedded in the project base PSF; paying OCR-record pricing on top of it is the opposite of the validated cheap-vs-peers signal.
history.rating_rationale: Validated forward signals are cheap-vs-district-peers and region; this listing maximally violates the first. IOD premium is priced-in (level, not a return edge). $3.79M quantum is far above the D19 4BR band - extremely thin exit pool in Buangkok. Resale CAGR ~2.9% is OCR-typical with no growth edge to grow into a ~40% entry premium over verified comps within a 5-7yr hold. Cheaper identical units in the same project dominate this one outright.
red_flags: Asking $2,862 psf vs trailing 12-month prints $1,875-$2,210 (avg ~$2,027) - ~30-40% over verified comps
Identical-size 4BR in same project listed at $2.99M ($2,258 psf) - this unit is +27% vs its direct competitor
$3.79M quantum far above the D19 4BR resale band - very thin buyer pool at exit
Integrated-development premium is a level premium already in the project base PSF - thesis double-counts it
Algo score 215/1000 (deep below threshold); 2.9% resale CAGR offers no path to absorb the entry premium
catalysts: Buangkok MRT (NE15) doorstep + Sengkang Grand Mall/hawker/bus interchange underpin rental demand (at fair entry, not this one)
Hougang Central integrated GLS launching ~$2,500+ psf may reprice the micro-market upward over time
Large 4BR format is scarce in the project - could command a premium to median, but not ~40%
